751-3755-7060.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2317-4826-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

2187-4113-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by tapping Possessed Skaab due to Essence Flux's convoke ability, blinking Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-5870-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-5870-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2112-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2112-3899-6972.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

147-728-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-728-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

413-1263-4871-4976.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Open the Graves and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

1619-4605-5231-5542-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6151.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Underdark Explorer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Underdark Explorer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Underdark Explorer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6151.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

876-5724-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Sage of the Maze.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Sage of the Maze.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Sage of the Maze.
Activate Sage of the Maze by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Sage of the Maze.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Sage of the Maze.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Sage of the Maze from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

4068-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites:
You control four or more Squirrels.
You control at least one Mountain.
4068-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4068-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2092-4954-7175.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Lavaleaper triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
2092-4954-7175.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

1355-4687-6287.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven enchantments.
1355-4687-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Sanctum Weaver.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G/U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

141-5188-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5188-5686.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-1379-2921-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-2060-3698-3750-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-3698-3750-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Overseer enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

1603-3372-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Evil Twin
1603-3372-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Evil Twin by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Evil Twin into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Evil Twin's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Evil Twin's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Evil Twin's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4863-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2034-4863-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Revolutionist and at least two other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing three of the creatures returned in step 1, adding six {C}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1491-2757-3129-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2757-3129-6218.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pheres-Band Tromper, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

3156-4763-4955-5173.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Shambling Ghast.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, targeting Koll.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

341-5078-5642.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

719-2907-3510.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
"Saproling" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2907-3510.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, creating either a 1/1 Insect creature token or a token copy of Scute Swarm.
When the creature token enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling that is also a Forest land due to Life and Limb and Xenograft, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Repeat from step 3.
NOTE: This combo creates an infinite mandatory loop that will draw the game if it is not interacted with.

232-732-1284-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder does not have summoning sickness.
232-732-1284-1636.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {2}{R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, holding priority, activate it by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
Repeat from step 3.

721-2724-3484.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Decoction Module by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
